# Vivacity — llms.txt
# Machine-readable product brief for AI assistants and scrapers.
# Canonical site: https://tryvivacity.com

> Vivacity is near-real-time video infrastructure for LLMs. It turns prompts, documents, and AI answers into mathematically exact, narrated explainer videos. API-first for EdTech, agents, and creator pipelines.

## Product
- Name: Vivacity
- Domain: https://tryvivacity.com
- Tagline: LLMs answer in text. We make it move.
- Category: Video infrastructure / AI explainer video API / Manim-grade STEM motion
- Contact: pavitra@paxus.in
- Founder site: https://pavitrakushwaha.dev
- Status: Early beta (invite code via /signin)

## What it does
- Ingest: prompt, document, or upstream model answer
- Scene IR: pedagogy plan and spoken math
- Voice: timed narration (English, Hindi, Hinglish)
- Motion: mathematically exact animation with QA repair
- Output: video_url via async jobs (POST /v1/jobs, GET /v1/jobs/:id)

## Differentiation
- Not a whiteboard doodle tool
- Optimizes for coordinated, correct diagrams (equations, graphs, spatial proofs)
- Unit economics designed for chatbot volume (~₹7 / ~$0.08 per careful short render)
